block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Diegetic monotonic calendar, 24h diurnal cycle, and nocturnal Dreamscape timing.
what_it_enables: Monotonic tracking of Seconds, Minutes, Hours (24h), Days (1-7), Weeks (1-4), Months (1-12), and Years
Diurnal illumination phases: Daytime, Dusk, Nocturnal Void, and Dawn
Nocturnal Dreamscape Window (20:00 to 04:00) driving slumber trials and void incursions
Festival of Accord countdown and calendar event dispatching
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations during calendar ticks (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Hours bounded strictly in [0, 23]; Minutes and Seconds bounded in [0, 59]
Day of week bounded in [1, 7]; Months bounded in [1, 12]
Time progresses forward monotonically; cannot reverse without explicit Debugger rewind

time_scale.description: Standard narrative pacing: 24 real minutes equals one full 24-hour game day.

diurnal_phases.description: First light breaking over Dio Village; fog lifts.
Standard market hours, road patrols active, NPC shops open.
Long shadows stretch; market stalls close; town guards light torches.
The Cosmic Veil thins. Dream Eaters manifest and slumber trials unlock.

tripwires.action: Clamp hour to valid 24h range; flag audit alert on corruption
